sections.content: Every HTML page starts with a boilerplate: <!DOCTYPE html>, an <html> root, a <head> for metadata, and a <body> for visible content.
The head holds the title (shown in the browser tab), links to CSS, and meta tags. The body holds everything the visitor sees.
Key points: always include the doctype, put metadata in head and content in body, and nesting must be correct — tags close in reverse order.
